title: Its ok
text: Its ok. This product is very cheaply made (even the plastic is cheap plastic) but its also cheap. I don't know if it will last more than one chanukah (not sure if it will be working next year when I get it out of storage) but it will be ok enough to use. If you are looking for something that you only need ot use for one Chanukah season then this is great. If you are looking for something durable, spend a little extra and get something better.
